title: David Established at Jerusalem

questions.question: Who sent messengers to David with cedar trees, masons, and carpenters?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 14:1 (ESV): "And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David..."

questions.question: What did the Philistines do when they heard David was anointed king?
options: They went up to search for David
questions.correctAnswer: They went up to search for David
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 14:8 (ESV): "...all the Philistines went up to search for David."

questions.question: What was the name of the place where David defeated the Philistines first?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 14:11 (ESV): "...David defeated them there. Then David said... Therefore the name of that place is called Baal-perazim."

questions.question: What command did God give David for the second battle?
options: Do not go up after them; go around and come upon them opposite the balsam trees
questions.correctAnswer: Do not go up after them; go around and come upon them opposite the balsam trees
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 14:14 (ESV): "...Do not go up after them; go around and come upon them opposite the balsam trees."

questions.question: What was the sign for David to strike?
options: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees
questions.correctAnswer: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 14:15 (ESV): "And when you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees, then go out to battle..."

questions.question: How many more wives did David take in Jerusalem?
options: The text doesn't say a number, but says he took more wives and concubines
questions.correctAnswer: The text doesn't say a number, but says he took more wives and concubines
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 14:3 (ESV): "And David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David fathered more sons and daughters."

questions.question: What did David do with the gods of the Philistines?
options: Ordered them to be burned with fire
questions.correctAnswer: Ordered them to be burned with fire
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 14:12 (ESV): "They left their gods there, and David gave command, and they were burned with fire."

questions.question: Where did the Philistines make a raid?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 14:9 (ESV): "Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the Valley of Rephaim."

questions.question: From where to where did David strike down the Philistine army?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 14:16 (ESV): "...and they struck down the Philistine army from Gibeon to Gezer."

questions.question: Why did David realize God had established him as king?
options: For the sake of his people Israel
questions.correctAnswer: For the sake of his people Israel
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 14:2 (ESV): "And David knew that the LORD had established him as king over Israel, and that his kingdom was highly exalted for the sake of his people Israel."

questions.question: Who are listed as sons of David born in Jerusalem?
options: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon, Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet, Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia, Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet
questions.correctAnswer: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon, Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet, Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia, Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet

questions.question: What did Hiram send besides cedar trees?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 14:1 (ESV): "...also masons and carpenters to build a house for him."

questions.question: What happened to the fame of David?
options: It went out into all lands, and the LORD brought the fear of him upon all nations
It was known only in Israel
questions.correctAnswer: It went out into all lands, and the LORD brought the fear of him upon all nations
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 14:17 (ESV): "And the fame of David went out into all lands, and the LORD brought the fear of him upon all nations."

questions.question: How many times did the Philistines raid the valley in this chapter?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 14:9 and 14:13 describe two distinct raids.

questions.question: What is the meaning of Baal-perazim?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 14:11 (ESV): "...God has broken through my enemies by my hand, like a bursting flood. Therefore the name of that place is called Baal-perazim."

key_verse_text: And the fame of David went out into all lands, and the LORD brought the fear of him upon all nations.
